claim: Patchline ships symbolic-execution hooks that explore a migration guard over its full space of symbolic inputs to decide whether any feasible path reaches an unsafe state, returning a concrete witness assignment when one exists, so an unsafe migration cannot hide behind an input combination a human reviewer failed to imagine. The worker enumerates the bounded symbolic domain of the guard variables, evaluates the guarded program on every assignment, reports which leaves are reachable, and produces a satisfying witness for any unsafe leaf, while a guard that is unsafe-free yields no such path. The gate proves the vulnerable guard exposes a reachable unsafe leaf with a witness and the hardened guard exposes none.
real_repo: patchline (self): bounded symbolic execution of migration guards
